Every modifier that can land on a ranged attack, from the printed Ranged Combat Modifiers Table (SR2 p.89). Modifiers are cumulative.

SituationModifier
Recoil, semi-automatic+1 for the second shot that Combat Phase
Recoil, burst-fire+3 per burst that Combat Phase
Recoil, full-auto+1 per round fired that Combat Phase
Recoil, heavy weapon2 × uncompensated recoil
Blind fire+8
Partial cover+4

Target running+2
Target stationary−1
Attacker in melee combat+2 per opponent
Attacker running+4
Attacker running (difficult ground)+6
Attacker walking+1
Attacker walking (difficult ground)+2
Attacker woundedsee Injury Modifier (p.112)
Smartlink (with smartgun)−2
Smart goggles (with smartgun)−1
Laser sight−1
Using a second firearm+2
Aimed shot−1 per Simple Action
Image magnificationspecial
Recoil compensationreduces the recoil modifier
Gyro stabilizationreduces the recoil or movement modifier

Recoil. Only recoil compensation or gyro stabilization counters it. Heavy weapons (medium/heavy MGs and shotguns) double the uncompensated recoil: an MMG firing 10 rounds with 6 points of compensation ends at +6 (9 − 6 = 3, doubled).

Visibility Table (SR2 p.89). Where an entry is split by a slash, the first number is for cybernetic or electronic vision and the second for natural metahuman vision; a single number applies to all vision types.

ConditionNormalLow-LightThermographic
Full darkness+8+8/+8+4/+2
Minimal light+6+4/+2+4/+2
Partial light+2+1/0+2/+1
Glare+2+4/+2+4/+2
Mist+2+2/00
Light smoke/fog/rain+4+4/+20
Heavy smoke/fog/rain+6+6/+4+1/0
Thermal smokeas smokeas smokeas normal

Full darkness is a complete absence of light, usually indoors or underground. Minimal light is a match, a small flashlight, moonlight. Partial light is the most common — city streets at night, a partly lit stairway. Glare is looking into the sun or a spotlight. Thermal smoke is engineered to blind thermographic vision, and does so the way ordinary smoke blinds ordinary sight.
